page.content:
Exploration and defense service of the Federation.

How Starfleet connects

  • Faction: Enterprise crew — The TOS Enterprise crew serves Starfleet.
  • Faction: Enterprise-D crew — The Enterprise-D crew serves Starfleet.
  • Faction: United Federation of Planets — Starfleet is the service arm of the Federation.
  • Faction: Voyager crew — Voyager remains a Starfleet crew in the Delta Quadrant.
  • Ship: USS Enterprise — The Enterprise is a Starfleet ship.
  • Concept: Prime Directive — Starfleet is bound by the Prime Directive.
  • Ship: USS Voyager — Voyager is a Starfleet Intrepid-class ship.
  • Faction: Klingon Empire — Early Starfleet treats the Klingon Empire as its great rival.

What is Starfleet?

Starfleet is the Federation's starship service — captains, science officers, and the Prime Directive — operating ships like Enterprise and Voyager.

Key threads lead to Enterprise crew, Enterprise-D crew, United Federation of Planets, Voyager crew, USS Enterprise and Prime Directive.
